Headline: #20 Madison buses Temporary Reroute at Madison/Kostner
ShortDescription: #20 Madison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to a street blockage near Madison/Kostner.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#20 Madison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Madison, Kostner, Jackson, Cicero, Madison and over regular route, due to a street blockage near Madison/Kostner.

Allow extra travel time.
